title: Tuki Tales — AI Sitemap
description: Machine-readable site map for AI agents. Describes the site's structure, sections, content categories, and primary actions an agent can take.

site.name: Tuki Tales
site.purpose: Promote the Tuki Tales YouTube channel — Hindi Nursery Rhymes & Kids Poems for children aged 1-6

sections.title: Hero
sections.description: Channel branding, headline, primary subscribe CTA, channel stats (15+ rhymes, ages 1-6, weekly uploads), and floating logo.

sections.title: Featured — Most Popular
sections.description: Auto-loads the most popular video by lifetime views. Updates live from YouTube.

sections.title: Popular Videos
sections.description: Grid of top 12 all-time popular videos, sorted by lifetime views. Live data from YouTube.

sections.title: Latest Videos
sections.description: Horizontal slider of 10 newest uploads, sorted by date (newest first). Live data via YouTube RSS feed.

sections.title: Shorts
sections.description: Vertical 9:16 shorts slider with hover-to-play preview (muted), mute/unmute + pause controls, and infinite scroll. Click opens full player with audio.

sections.title: Playlists
sections.description: Curated channel playlists, sorted by popularity. Live data. Each card shows thumbnail + video count + title.

sections.title: About Tuki Tales
sections.description: Hindi-language description of the channel, its mission, and 8 colorful category tags (Nursery Rhymes, Kids Poems, Cartoon Videos, Sing-Along Songs, Lori & Lullabies, Alphabet & Counting, Family Friendly, Musical Stories).

sections.title: Join the Family
sections.description: Final subscribe call-to-action with gradient background.

audience.primary: Parents and caregivers of Hindi-speaking children aged 1-6
audience.geography: India and the global Hindi diaspora

tech_stack: Static HTML/CSS/JS — no build step, no framework
Hosted on Netlify (auto-deployed from GitHub main branch)
Live YouTube data via CORS proxy (api.allorigins.win)
Latest videos via YouTube RSS feed
Video titles via YouTube oEmbed API

tracking_events.trigger: click on a video card in Popular grid or Latest slider
click on See All Popular button
click on View All Shorts button
click on See All Playlists button
click on Browse All Videos button
click on Watch Popular Videos in hero
click on a social media link in footer
